description: Configuration for the AWS cloud-burst Provisioner backend (ARC-13 / ADR-20, #377), the AWS sibling of the reference AzureConfig: where on AWS to burst ephemeral compute nodes, how to size and price them, and how each node joins the cluster. Mirrored by zetta::AwsConfig in include/zetta/aws_provisioner.hpp and enforced by AwsConfig::from_json() in src/core/aws_provisioner.cpp — keep them in sync. No cloud SDK lives behind the provisioner; this config is interpreted by an AwsControlPlane (the reference AwsCliControlPlane shells out to the `aws` CLI, driving an EC2 Auto Scaling Group). A malformed config is rejected at the boundary so a misconfigured burst fails fast instead of bringing up the wrong (or unbounded) fleet.

instance_type.description: An EC2 instance type override (e.g. 'g5.xlarge', 'p4d.24xlarge') applied via the ASG's mixed-instances policy. Empty uses the launch template's instance type.

launch_template.description: The EC2 launch template name the Auto Scaling Group launches instances from — it defines the AMI, the default instance type, the IAM instance profile (the per-node AWS identity), and the user-data (the cluster-join bootstrap).

max_price.description: Spot max price per node-hour (USD). AWS convention: 0 (or omitted) places no explicit cap, so Spot is capped at the On-Demand price. Applies only when spot is true.

pool_name.description: Name of the burst pool (the EC2 Auto Scaling Group). Stable so create + scale + delete are idempotent. Defaults to 'zetta-burst' when omitted.

profile.description: Optional AWS CLI named profile (which credentials/config the `aws` commands run under). Empty uses the default profile / ambient credentials.

region.description: The AWS region the burst nodes launch into (e.g. 'us-west-2', 'eu-west-1').

seed_peer.description: The cluster seed address (host:port) handed to each node's bootstrap so it auto-joins the existing peer cluster at boot. Empty when the join address is supplied another way (e.g. baked into the launch template's user-data).

spot.description: Burst Spot capacity (cheaper, interruptible) rather than On-Demand, via the ASG's mixed-instances policy.

subnets.description: Comma-separated VPC subnet ids the burst nodes launch into (the ASG's --vpc-zone-identifier).

title: AwsConfig
